## tab_main

**Table 1.** Main results of multi-round RSI (v3+GRPO, round 3) on the locked test pools. Locked tests: MedQA 500, MMLU-Pro 500 (test), GPQA 100, AQuA-RAT 254. Acc.: accuracy (%); Calls: advisor calls per question; Tok.: total tokens per question (manager and advisors, prefill and decode). Δ rows: accuracy change vs. S₁ in points with the two-sided paired-bootstrap p (10k resamples). Bold: best accuracy per benchmark; RSI (success) calls an advisor on nearly every question (call rate at least 0.99). GRPO accepted: FA-GRPO stages accepted by the development gate out of three rounds; a rejected stage keeps that round's SFT manager. Total tokens were not measured (–) for MARGENT RSI (static) on MMLU-Pro and AQuA-RAT, and for MARGENT RSI (success) on MedQA, MMLU-Pro and AQuA-RAT. †: S₁ tokens on MMLU-Pro and AQuA-RAT were not re-measured in the v3+GRPO run; the value is from the no-GRPO (v3) re-evaluation of the same S₁ checkpoint.
